source: Observed OpenCode 1.18.32 provider definitions; exact hash guard

bash.description:
Run a terminal command (Linux/bash); command required, timeout in ms (default 120000). Use workdir, not cd &&; quote paths containing spaces. Before creating files/directories, verify the parent exists and is intended. Use /tmp/opencode for approved temporary work. Prefer Glob/Grep/Read/Edit/Write for file operations; use shell only when explicitly requested or necessary. Match counts may use rg, not grep. Communicate directly, not with echo/printf. Capture output; >2000 lines or 51200 bytes is saved/truncated automatically: use Read offset/limit or Grep on that file, not head/tail. Independent commands can be parallel calls; dependent commands use &&; use ; only if later commands may run despite failure. No newline-separated commands (quoted strings may contain newlines).
Git: commit, amend, push or PR only on explicit request. Before commit inspect status, diff and log --oneline -10; stage intended files only, never secrets; concise repository-style message. No git config changes, skipped hooks, interactive -i, force push or empty commits unless explicitly requested. After failed commit/hooks, fix and create a new commit; do not amend the failed commit. Before PR inspect status, diff, remote tracking, recent commits and base-branch diff; review every included commit. Use gh for GitHub and return the PR URL.

edit.description: Replace exact text in an existing file. Read the file first in this conversation; otherwise editing fails. Preserve indentation; omit Read's line-number prefixes from oldString/newString. oldString must match uniquely: if absent, reread; if multiple matches, add surrounding context or set replaceAll to change every occurrence. Prefer editing existing files; create files only when required. No emojis unless requested.

read.description: Read a local file or directory using an absolute filePath; missing paths error. Default: up to 2000 lines, offset is 1-based; use limit and larger offsets for later sections. Lines are prefixed "number: content" (not part of the file); directory entries have no line numbers and directories end in /. Lines over 2000 characters truncate. Use Grep for targeted content/long lines and Glob for uncertain filenames. Batch independent reads; avoid tiny repeated 30-line slices. Images/PDFs can be returned as attachments.

write.description: Write a file, overwriting it if it exists. Read any existing file first in this conversation or this tool fails. Prefer Edit for existing files; create files only when required. Do not proactively create Markdown documentation/README files unless the user explicitly requested them. No emojis unless requested.

glob.description: Find paths by glob pattern, e.g. **/*.js or src/**/*.ts. Batch independent useful searches. For open-ended exploration requiring repeated glob/grep rounds, use Task when delegation is permitted.

grep.description: Search file contents by regex; optional include glob, e.g. *.{ts,tsx}. Returns matching paths and line numbers. For match counts use Bash with rg, not grep. For open-ended repeated searches use Task when delegation is permitted.
